name: droply-monorepo
description: Droply - Zero-knowledge end-to-end encrypted P2P file sharing utility (CLI & Web)

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter=!@droply/web run build && pnpm --filter @droply/web run build
scripts.test: pnpm -r --filter=!@droply/web run build && pnpm -r run test
scripts.check: pnpm -r --filter=!@droply/web run build && pnpm -r run check
scripts.build:bin: pnpm run bundle:cli && mkdir -p dist && node --experimental-sea-config sea-config.json
